content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text makes lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity the reason for marking the link UNDERDETERMINED.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
